sequences.indoor: TUM fr3_structure_texture_far, start2s after first RGB, nearest 5Hz,20 frames
sequences.outdoor: KITTI Raw 2011_09_26_drive_0005_sync image02, frames50..88 step2 (5Hz),20 frames
sequences.drone: EuRoC MAV V1_01_easy cam0, start10s after first common valid image/pose, nearest5Hz,20 frames; actual indoor drone flight, monochrome camera repeated to RGB

scope: pilot short temporal clips, one per category, not long-duration online SLAM or independently generalizable benchmark
camera_condition: provided calibrated K and provided trajectory fixed as camera-error control; external pose GT/GPS-IMU is an optimization input, so not an end-to-end RGB-only deployment demonstration; depth/LiDAR/room scan GT used only after correction

model.context: first16 mapping RGB jointly once, future4 excluded from VGGT input; fixed raw cache and scale reused across all prefix comparisons. Offline optimization evidence accumulation, not causal online network inference.
model.OOM_policy: preserve failure and freeze all-three resolution256 before any depth GT evaluation; do not silently lower only one sequence

mask_policy: one common physical plane per sequence, agent RGB-only polygons in each frame; no user review as authorized; frozen before raw depth inspection/depth GT evaluation

matching.images: same undistorted native crop capped768, never upsample
matching.edges: adjacent pairs plus source0-to-each and mapping15-to-future16..19
matching.track_split: global track component hash seed0 70/30; conflicting duplicate-view components discarded; fixed all frames so prefixes never resplit
matching.plane_tracks: temporal Shi-Tomasi/LK tracks, native capped768, win15 maxlevel4, forward/backward <=0.5 processed px, epipolar<=1px; reseed within plane excluding radius6 native pixels around all existing tracks. Track seed ID fixed for lifetime; no new seeds in future frames16..19.
matching.SIFT_role: global appearance tracks on listed edges for independent RGB triangulated clip scale; not used as replacement selected by GT

scale: one positive clip scale from FIT RGB tracks triangulated with provided metric poses among mapping0..15 only, maximum parallax positive pair per physical track; fixed for every prefix/arm, no depth GT
arms: B2 fixed raw normal feature distance
prefix_fit: all FIT track observation pairs on mapping indices less than N, within frozen same-plane polygons; future16..19 never used for fitting; correspondence support tracks>=12 and track-heldout>=6, maximum per-observed-view FIT hull>=0.1; source0 hull reported but not required, median fitted ray parallax>=1deg, Jacobian singular ratio>1e-6. Failure retains raw B0 with explicit status.
heldout: track-heldout on available mapping frames and separate future-view pairs to mapping15/source0; future-view observation tracks never affect scale/plane fits. RGB correspondences are not geometric GT.
optimization: unchanged fixed-camera shared world-plane bidirectional radial Huber1px; raw plus FIT linear seed; original P8 one-degree cone; positive depth on all prefix polygon vertices; no GT-based arm/prefix selection

depth_GT.indoor: TUM registered depth PNG /5000, nearest sample, missing stays missing
depth_GT.outdoor: same-time Velodyne transformed using official calibration, nearest processed pixel Z-buffer, no fill or motion compensation; sparse sensor reference, not occlusion-perfect GT
depth_GT.drone: EuRoC pointcloud0 scanner coordinates via T_WR and provided camera poses, nearest processed pixel Z-buffer, no filling; sensor-projected reference not official dense depth benchmark

evaluation: separate post-fit stage reads depth/point GT; source0 ROI accuracy across N with identical pixels, per-frame ROI accuracy where meaningful; normals against GT reference plane, matching/future reprojection, rank/parallax and mask/visibility diagnostics; no cross-dataset pooled mean; RGB clips and raw/corrected/GT images/videos with provenance. No RGB-boundary segmentation, learned refinement, loop closure or pose optimization.
pre_matching_amendment: Before any feature extraction/depth inspection/GT-depth read: use P1c-style temporal LK for plane observations, since P10 follows continuous RGB and existing P1c road matching policy. SIFT remains global scale source. No matching outcomes used to tune this amendment.
original_strict_source0_gate: all FIT track observation pairs on mapping indices less than N, within frozen same-plane polygons; future16..19 never used for fitting; correspondence support tracks>=12 and track-heldout>=6, source0 FIT hull>=0.1, median fitted ray parallax>=1deg, Jacobian singular ratio>1e-6. Failure retains raw B0 with explicit status.
pre_depth_GT_gate_amendment: Original strict fit-001 retained. Because source0 outdoor plane has no tracked features but later same-plane views do, fit-002 permits sufficiently distributed support in any observed view, retaining counts,1deg parallax and global Jacobian rank. Same masks/frames/raw/scale/solver, no GT-depth inspection or threshold lowering; tests global planar evidence rather than mandatory reference-image visibility.
